"Create a complete, realistic and interactive makeup simulator called \"Ultimate Makeup Studio\". Players must be able to perform an entire makeup transformation from scratch, using professional beauty products and tools. This must be a fully playable game, not just a dress-up interface.

MODELS: Include diverse male and female models with customizable skin tones, undertones, face shapes, eyes, noses, lips, freckles, beauty marks and facial features.

SKINCARE: Include cleanser, toner, moisturizer, serum, sunscreen, eye cream, primer and lip balm, all with interactive application.

FACE MAKEUP: Include liquid, matte and dewy foundations, skin tints, BB cream, CC cream, color correctors, concealers, cream and powder contour, bronzer, blush, highlighter, loose powder, pressed powder and setting spray. Every product must have multiple shades, finishes and adjustable opacity.

TOOLS: Include beauty blenders, mini sponges, powder puffs, foundation brushes, concealer brushes, contour brushes, blush brushes, fan brushes, eyeshadow brushes, blending brushes, angled brushes and lip brushes. Players must physically drag, tap, dab and blend products onto the face. Sponges must realistically blend makeup. Allow adjustable brush size, pressure and intensity.

EYEBROWS: Customize shape, thickness, length, arch and color. Include pencils, pomades, gels, powders and individual hair strokes.

EYESHADOW: Provide a huge palette with matte, shimmer, glitter, metallic, chrome, satin and duochrome shades. Allow precise application to the eyelid, crease, inner corner, outer corner, lower lash line and brow bone. Support multiple colors and blending. Include smokey eyes, cut crease, halo eyes and colorful styles.

EYELINER AND LASHES: Include pencil, liquid, gel, graphic, winged and colored eyeliner. Customize shape, thickness and length. Add mascara with an interactive wand and false lashes with customizable length, volume, curl, density, thickness and color.

LIPS: Include lipstick, gloss, lip oil, tint, liner and liquid lipstick. Customize color, shine, opacity and finish. Support ombre, gradient and blurred lip techniques.

HAIR: Include hundreds of hairstyles: straight, curly, wavy, braids, buns, ponytails, bobs, wolf cuts, layers and bangs. Customize length, volume, texture, roots, highlights, lowlights, ombre and color.

ACCESSORIES: Add earrings, necklaces, glasses, rings, piercings, hair clips, headbands and customizable nails with different shapes, lengths, colors and nail art.

GAME MODES: Include Free Makeup, Professional Mode, Beauty Challenges and Client Requests. Clients can request Korean makeup, clean girl, soft glam, full glam, wedding, gothic, Y2K and editorial looks. Score precision, creativity and client satisfaction.

STUDIO: Create a customizable professional makeup studio with illuminated mirrors, vanity tables, organizers, drawers, ring lights and decorations.

FEATURES: Include product categories, custom palettes, favorites, product previews, undo, redo, erase, reset, zoom, camera rotation and close-ups of eyes and lips. Allow players to save projects, compare before-and-after results, create portfolios and export screenshots.

IMPORTANT: Every product, tool, button and customization option must work. Makeup must be applied directly to the model's face through real interactive movements, not flat stickers. Make blending, layering, coverage and textures realistic. Create smooth animations, beautiful graphics and an elegant interface. Optimize everything for mobile touchscreens, tablets and computers. Prioritize functional gameplay over decorative menus.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

1: ## Process lifecycle
2: 
3: - Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
4: - Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
5: - After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.
6: 
7: ## Linux browser and WebGPU capture
8: 
9: - Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
10: - Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
11: - Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
12: - Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
13: - Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
14: - Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
15: - Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
16: - Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
17: - Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

## Objective
- Build “Ultimate Makeup Studio,” a complete, playable makeup transformation game in the existing project.

## Requirements
- Include diverse customizable models, skincare and makeup products, interactive tools and application, hair and accessories, game modes and client requests, studio customization, and save/compare/portfolio/export features.
- Makeup should be applied through direct face interaction, with blending, layering, adjustable opacity and tool controls.
- Create an elegant, responsive experience that works on mobile, tablet, and desktop. Do not ask clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- Use a self-contained HTML/CSS/JavaScript game with an inline SVG face model and browser local storage.
- The implementation uses reasonable approximations for face geometry and makeup rendering rather than external assets or dependencies.

## Work State
### Completed
- Drafted UI, SVG model, product catalog, customization and game-interaction code during the session.

### Active
- Rebuild `index.html` correctly: the latest write replaced the file with only partial markup, so the game is currently incomplete and nonfunctional.
- Run syntax checks and browser verification after the file is repaired.

### Blocked
- Current `index.html` is incomplete: it begins with `<main class="workspace">` and ends inside the face SVG, without the rest of the document, closing tags, styles, or JavaScript.

## Next Move
1. Inspect the current `index.html` and rebuild it as one complete document, or append subsequent sections using targeted edits rather than replacing the entire file.
2. Run JavaScript syntax checks and launch the game.
3. Test core interactions in-browser: product selection, direct face application, tools/blending, undo/redo, customization, saving, comparison, and export.
4. Fix issues found and capture a screenshot for visual review.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Intended game implementation; currently overwritten with incomplete HTML.

## Important Context
- A `node --check /tmp/ums.js` attempt failed because the file had no `<script>` tag to extract; the reported error was `IndexError: list index out of range`.
- No browser verification or screenshot was completed, and changes have not been committed.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build “Ultimate Makeup Studio,” a polished, playable makeup transformation game in the existing project.
- Support responsive play with direct face interaction and a broad set of beauty tools and studio features.

## Requirements
- Include diverse models, customization, makeup categories, game modes, client requests, and studio décor.
- Support drag/tap makeup application, blending, layering, opacity and brush controls.
- Include erase, undo/redo, reset, zoom, compare, save, portfolio and export.
- Support mobile, tablet and desktop; no clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- Implement as a self-contained HTML/CSS/JavaScript game with inline SVG face art and browser local storage.
- Approximate face geometry and makeup rendering without external assets or dependencies.

## Work State
### Completed
- Rebuilt `index.html` as a complete, styled game with model and appearance customization, product categories and shades, direct face painting, brush controls, and responsive layouts.
- Implemented erase, blend, undo/redo, reset, zoom, compare, studio toggles, client/challenge modes, saved portfolio, and SVG export.
- Confirmed JavaScript syntax with `new Function(...)`; generated a Chromium screenshot at `/tmp/opencode/atelier.png`.
- Confirmed browser interaction can add makeup to the face canvas.

### Active
- Verify undo/redo, erase, save/load, export, compare, and mobile behavior in-browser; fix any issues found.

### Blocked
- Comprehensive interaction verification remains incomplete; a browser test attempt failed due to test-script errors/timeouts.

## Next Move
1. Run browser checks for applying makeup, erasing, undo/redo, save/load, compare, and SVG export; distinguish application issues from test-harness errors.
2. Check mobile layout and screenshot, then address any usability or rendering issues.
3. Review `git status` and report the uncommitted changes.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete game implementation; current changes are uncommitted.

## Important Context
- The document is self-contained; no successful comprehensive end-to-end test has yet verified all features.
